title: Melodie bi yëngal tundu yi
intro: Danga bëgga fësal jaar-jaaru benn jaamu Yàlla bu yéeme. Ci réewu ndaw yi ak njiit yi, nit ki dañu ko barkeel ci téere bu Yàlla jox, baat bu am doole, ak doole ju ëpp wen. Sooy jàng tegtal yi, ndax mën nga xam kan lay wax?
clues: Jaamu Yàlla laa woon ñu jox téere bu amul fenn.
Amoon naa baat bu neex, te sama gëdd neexoon na lool ba sax tundu yi ak picc yi ànd ak man.
Dama jànkoonte ak noon bu mag ci xare bu siiw, te doonte maa ngi gëna ndaw, maa daan.
Dañu defar wen wu yomb, loolu tax ma mëna defar ay gànnaay ak samay loxo.
Ñu def ma kilifag réew mu mag, te sama xam-xam ci àtte siiw na.
Sama doom, moom itam yonent la, ñu may ko mu yor ngelaw li ak jinn yi.

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Nekk na yonent ak buur ci Israyil
Ñu yéegal ko ci asamaan si
outcome.answer: Nekk na yonent ak buur ci Israyil

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
